normalization_and_observer_difference.legacy_V6: Immutable Stage11 cached y: only value coordinates3 and4 are mean/std normalized over the complete active recording before cropping. Std floor1/255. Other coordinates are unchanged by that record-relative transform.
normalization_and_observer_difference.legacy_VAL_self_normalization: Each historicalVAL recording has its own full-active-record-relative legacy value transform. This is not a TRAIN-fitted transform and can use frames outside the selected64s window.
normalization_and_observer_difference.new_global_statistics: TRAIN-only global audio and auxiliary normalizers, palette vocabulary, event thresholds and weights are required; inspected fit_transforms rejects mixed/nonTRAIN records and audio normalization rejects nonTRAIN rows.

selection_audit.canonical_sort: SHA256(UTF8(campaign_id + cohort-v1 + canonical_id)); ascending hexdigest, no separators
selection_audit.hash_integrity: Every selected input_metadata_sha256 and source_metadata_sha256 recomputed exactly; source/pose/WAV/bus hash declarations match original manifest; protocol and candidate hashes exact.

original_gate.scope: Source enrollment coverage, not model performance; neither waived nor relabeled.

selection_audit.replay_instrument: Stored source-only qualification decisions, original metadata and independently recomputed order; no raw pose remeasurement in this audit.
selection_audit.source_rule: Joint presence of all explicit registered coach indices >=0.90 on both64s and center8s, raw pose timestamps <=0.2s gap, readable sources and fixed global0.1s centered window.
selection_audit.strict_candidate_unchanged: Strict97TRAIN+14VAL candidate remains a separate prior source-completeness artifact; supplemental policy did not overwrite it.

source_byte_verification_provenance.capture: Parent reports source/pose byte checks passed before CUDA. Inspected visual.validate_manifest hashes every selected source and pose; visual.run calls it before constructing SAM2FrameSegmenter.
source_byte_verification_provenance.no_independent_runtime_completion_attest: Source-code order is verified; capture outcome or completion was not read and is not certified here.
source_byte_verification_provenance.qualification: Earlier source qualification verified every selected pose, WAV and audio-bus file against expected hashes; source video hash was then deferred.

temporal_context.input_pipeline: Full source WAV -> full-record40Hz audio bus with offline global beat grid and full-record BeatThis50Hz logits -> aligned40Hz feature sequence ->64s feature window.
notes: Some audio spectral channels use causal framing. The complete bus still contains globally fitted oracle beat channels, so the whole feature input is not causal.
BeatThis extraction passes the complete source audio to the frozen predictor; no64s raw-audio truncation occurs before feature construction.
All arms and deployable audio-only controls must receive equivalent full-source feature provenance. A64s feature crop does not establish a64s raw-context bound.

source_evidence.detail: Reads complete audio then invokes predictor(audio,sr).
Offline global beat fitting; oracle_beat flag true.
Full-record audio/rhythm assembled before absolute-time64s feature sampling.
